answer_1.quote: OLIVE consists of 9,450 images, 30,120 unique instructions, and 47,250 responses.
answer_1.outputs: The outputs include image captions, answers to visual questions, explanations, rankings, and open-ended responses to diverse instructions.

answer_2.quote: The performance metrics used are AUC for Hateful Memes, CIDEr for OpenCQA, OLIVE, and all captioning datasets, ROUGE-L (Lin, 2004) for MORE and New Yorker Explanation, and accuracy for the remaining tasks.

answer_4.quote: we hire an annotation company, Flitto, to thoroughly review and correct any errors presented in the data.
answer_4.guideline: 1) ensure that the instructions contain minimal shortcut information, which could enable the model to produce correct outputs without having to understand the image, 2) verify the accuracy of the output and confirm that it is free from harmful content, and 3) fact-check knowledge-based information.
